ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a circle. F and H are at the left and right ends of the circle, and segment FH is a diameter passing horizontally through the circle; G and J are respectively above and below the circle, and GJ is a vertical segment perpendicular to FH. Angle 1 is labeled at point H and is an inscribed angle formed by HF and HJ. The problem gives the measure of arc JH as 114°. Reasoning: Because FH is a diameter, the measure of the lower semicircular arc FH passing through J is 180°. This lower semicircular arc is composed of arc FJ and arc JH, so m arc FJ = 180° - 114° = 66°. Angle 1 is an inscribed angle, and its intercepted arc is FJ, so m∠1 = 1/2 × 66° = 33°.

method.method_draft: 先看图像：这是一个圆，F到H是一条穿过圆心的水平直径，G到J是一条竖直直径；角1标在点H处，是由直线HF和弦HJ形成的角。再看文字：给出弧JH的度数是114°。因为FH是直径，所以从F到H经过J的下半圆弧总共是180°，因此弧FJ = 180° - 114° = 66°。最后用圆周角定理：角1所对的是弧FJ，所以 m∠1 = 1/2 × 66° = 33°。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个圆，F 和 H 在圆的左右两端，线段 FH 是水平穿过圆的直径；G 和 J 分别在圆的上、下方，GJ 是竖直线段并与 FH 垂直。角 1 标在点 H 处，是由 HF 和 HJ 形成的圆周角。题目给出弧 JH 的度数为 114°。
推理：因为 FH 是直径，所以经过 J 的下半圆弧 FH 的度数是 180°。这条下半圆弧由弧 FJ 和弧 JH 组成，因此 m弧FJ = 180° - 114° = 66°。角 1 是圆周角，它所对的弧是 FJ，所以 m∠1 = 1/2 × 66° = 33°。
